adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the diff sets `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and then unconditionally applies `group.users...limit(limit)` for all groups, with no upper bound/cap. This makes it possible for a client to request an arbitrarily large `limit` (e.g. `members.json?limit=999999999`), potentially causing an expensive query/response and enabling DoS-style abuse. The prior code only applied pagination/limit logic for `automatic?` groups and used a default of 200, but still did not introduce a cap; the new code expands the unbounded limit behavior to all groups and removes the prior context/comment without adding a safeguard.
